title: Update app color theme to closely match the provided reference site

requirements.text: Update the app’s global color theme (light + dark) to closely match the look-and-feel of the provided reference site: https://ecyknw7fo3zty.ok.kimi.link/?fbclid=PAT01DUAP-4YZleHRuA2FlbQIxMABzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA81NjcwNjczNDMzNTI0MjcAAadMuj_NcTEPcwDBSvYuAwCrJLUe3-xApO-Gj-LgENU-v-KuAM0nH5yjM7y3QQ_aem_Q9KLBwgFpUm9Uo-4Et5ACw . Implement this by updating the existing Tailwind/Shadcn theme tokens (CSS variables) in frontend/src/index.css so the new palette propagates consistently across all existing UI components (nav, cards, headings, buttons, simulator panels, videos gallery, help bot). Keep RTL behavior unchanged.

quotes: هل يمكنك أن تغير الوان و تجعلها نتا هدا موقع https://ecyknw7fo3zty.ok.kimi.link/?fbclid=PAT01DUAP-4YZleHRuA2FlbQIxMABzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA81NjcwNjczNDMzNTI0MjcAAadMuj_NcTEPcwDBSvYuAwCrJLUe3-xApO-Gj-LgENU-v-KuAM0nH5yjM7y3QQ_aem_Q9KLBwgFpUm9Uo-4Et5ACw

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/index.css updates the existing :root and .dark CSS variable tokens (e.g., --background, --foreground, --card, --primary, --accent, --muted, --border, --ring) to a new palette intended to match the reference site.
No hard-coded hex colors are introduced in components for theming; components continue to rely on the existing Tailwind token classes (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, text-primary, etc.).

The app remains readable (sufficient contrast) across major UI surfaces: TopNav, IntroSplash, section cards, Pros/Cons cards, simulator controls/outputs, videos gallery, and help bot panel, in both light and dark modes.
RTL layout and Arabic content remain unchanged (direction: rtl still applies, and no layout regressions are introduced).

requirements.text: Adjust key high-visibility UI surfaces to align with the new theme styling (without changing features or content): Top navigation bar, Intro splash gradient/background treatment, decorated section headings, and the floating help-bot trigger/panel. Use only Tailwind classes and existing theme tokens so the styling matches the updated palette and remains consistent.

quotes: هل يمكنك أن تغير الوان و تجعلها نتا هدا موقع https://ecyknw7fo3zty.ok.kimi.link/?fbclid=PAT01DUAP-4YZleHRuA2FlbQIxMABzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA81NjcwNjczNDMzNTI0MjcAAadMuj_NcTEPcwDBSvYuAwCrJLUe3-xApO-Gj-LgENU-v-KuAM0nH5yjM7y3QQ_aem_Q9KLBwgFpUm9Uo-4Et5ACw

acceptanceCriteria: TopNav visually matches the updated theme (background translucency, borders, hover states) and remains sticky and usable on desktop and mobile.
IntroSplash background gradient uses updated token-based colors (from-background/via-accent/to-background or equivalent), and the CTA button styling remains consistent with the new primary color.
DecoratedHeading continues to use the existing structure but its accent elements (icon container, gradient bar) reflect the updated palette and keep strong visual hierarchy in RTL.
HelpBotPanel trigger button and panel header/body styling align with updated theme tokens (primary/accent/card/border) and remain readable and accessible.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI component sources); only compose and style through app-level components and theme tokens.
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep the current app language and RTL layout behavior unchanged while updating the visual theme.
Do not introduce new backend logic; theming is a frontend-only change.
nonGoals: Rebuilding the app to be identical pixel-for-pixel to the reference site (only a close thematic match is required).
Changing content structure, adding new sections/features, or rewriting Arabic text content as part of the theme update.
Adding new authentication providers or any third-party integrations.
